name: Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager
summary: Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager deploys Terraform configurations to Google Cloud. Preview deployments show the effect of a change before it is applied, and the service keeps a state file for each deployment and revision. Google's pricing page says the service itself has no fee, and that Cloud Build and Cloud Storage are billed separately.

facts.text: The Infrastructure Manager overview says Terraform is defined declaratively in a Terraform configuration that describes the end state of the infrastructure.
The overview says preview deployments show how changes affect the infrastructure before they are applied.
The overview says Infrastructure Manager stores the state file created as part of each deployment and revision.
Per the pricing page, there is no fee for Infrastructure Manager itself. Cloud Build and Cloud Storage are the services that bill for its runs and artifacts.

plans.name: Infrastructure Manager
plans.unit: per deployment, no fee for the service
plans.notes: No fee for the service itself. Cloud Build and Cloud Storage bill separately.

hiddenCosts: Infrastructure Manager runs Terraform through Cloud Build, which charges for build minutes above the amount included.
The service creates a Cloud Storage bucket for provisioning artifacts, which is billed at Cloud Storage rates.
